Presenting the full video song "Wafa Na Raas Aayee Tujhe O Harjaee" from the Bollywood movie 'Bewafa Sanam' featuring Krishan Kumar & Shilpa Shirodkar in the lead roles. This song is sung by Nitin Mukesh and the music is composed by Nikhil, Vinay, Milind Sagar.
Song - Wafa Na Raas Aayee Tujhe O Harjaee
Film - Bewafa Sanam
Singer - Nitin Mukesh
Lyricist - Sadique, Shafir, Ishrat, Katil Shifai, Yogesh
Music Director - Nikhil, Vinay, Milind Sagar
Artist - Krishan Kumar, Shilpa Shirodkar
Music On - T-Series
